title: Final pressure value
description: Essential: The final pressure must be calculated and stated as approximately 1.3 × 10⁵ Pa.

title: Initial gas volume
description: Important: The student must correctly calculate the initial gas volume in the bottle by subtracting the liquid volume from the total bottle volume.

title: Syringe gas volume
description: Important: The student must correctly calculate the volume of gas in the syringe using the cylinder volume formula.

title: Apply Boyle's Law
description: Important: The solution must apply Boyle's Law (p₁V₁ = p₂V₂) to the combined system, recognizing the initial pressure is the same for both volumes.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The solution should demonstrate consistent unit handling (e.g., converting mL to cm³ or m³) throughout the calculation.

title: Incorrect volume sum
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly sums volumes (e.g., adds the liquid volume) or misidentifies the final total volume.

title: Pressure assumption error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student assumes the final pressure is simply the sum of the initial pressures or makes another incorrect assumption about pressure equilibrium.
